# Crisam De Gracia (Sam)

> Portfolio of Crisam "Sam" De Gracia: web design and development, with technical SEO and AI automation. Founder of Auriros, a digital marketing studio. Based in the Philippines, working with clients worldwide.

## What I do

- Web design and development: fast, easy-to-manage sites on WordPress, Astro or custom code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP), built to look sharp and turn visitors into leads.
- SEO and AEO: technical SEO, structured data, tracking (Search Console, Analytics, Tag Manager) and answer engine optimization, so sites get found on Google and cited by AI.
- AI automation: AI agents, workflows and content pipelines built with n8n and LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini), with a human review step where it matters.

## Selected work

- Websites for clients in the Philippines, Japan and Singapore (WordPress, Elementor, custom PHP), including instax Pal, USSC (U Money), Shiodome and HC Mutual.
- Auriros: my own studio site (Astro, Cloudflare Pages), with AI-assisted imagery and answer-first content.
- On-page SEO for Canadian small businesses, tracked in Semrush.
- Automated blog content pipeline: keyword batch to scheduled WordPress post using n8n, Claude and Postgres, with human review.

I have 9 years of experience building websites.
